paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: Training loss curves for the post-training setting.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training loss curves for the post-training setting of different configurations of SepLLM and a baseline "Vanilla before post-training" model. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale, ranges from 90000 to 130000, and has tick labels at intervals of 5000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss", has a linear scale, ranges from 2.0 to 3.0, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot includes four lines representing different models: SepLLM (n=64, larger lr) shown in magenta with a solid line style, SepLLM (n=128) in blue with a solid line style, SepLLM (n=64) in orange with a solid line style, and Vanilla before post-training in red with a dashed line style. The magenta line starts at a loss of approximately 3.0 at 90000 iterations and decreases to around 2.2 at 127000 iterations. The blue line begins at a loss of about 2.95 at 90000 iterations and drops to roughly 2.25 at 127000 iterations. The orange line commences at a loss of approximately 3.0 at 90000 iterations and falls to around 2.3 at 127000 iterations. The red dashed line remains constant at a loss of 2.35 across all iterations. All three SepLLM lines exhibit a declining trend, with the magenta line (n=64, larger lr) showing the most pronounced decrease.
